note: Strict retailer-only production: direct Amazon/Cdiscount/Joybuy products, no Dealabs/other forum notices, no clothing or tabletop games. Amazon direct discovery requires provider access; Cdiscount/Joybuy direct discovery not yet live.

deal_delivery.note: Every allowed category, same 25% threshold. Retailer-only direct quotes, no priority categories, no forum posts.

daily_report.include: number_of_posts_scanned, new_candidates, confirmed_deals_if_any, notable_offers and source/verification caveats
daily_report.note: Daily report generated from cached RSS scan counts. GitHub Actions scheduling is not exact, may be delayed or missed.

source_only_promising_alerts.name: Перспективная находка
source_only_promising_alerts.note: Source-only informational alert. An editorial offer page may point to a merchant other than Amazon; user must check merchant, live price, delivery and whether the offer is even on Amazon. No guarantee source discount is genuine.

preferred_sources: RSS item media:thumbnail / media:content / enclosure / item img
images.caption_disclaimer: Фото из публикации, соответствие товару не подтверждено.
images.fallback_if_missing_or_telegram_rejects: send original text alert with all links and warnings
images.note: Photo delivery attempted when the image URL is safe and the entire caption fits the Telegram photo limit; not every offer includes an image.

effective_price_components: coupon or Prime conditions if eligible

interior_design_profile.name: Bauhaus / Nordic / Playful Modern / IKEA 1980s–1990s aesthetics
lower_priority_styles: generic mass-market home goods without recognizable design
interior_design_profile.condition: new only; vintage-look designs welcomed but physically used or refurbished items excluded
interior_design_profile.note: RSS keyword/style matching only: no computer vision or verified aesthetic classification, no guarantee a listed item looks like this.

unexpected_diamond.note: Outside selected categories, alert on stated 80%+ reductions for recognizable brands; declared savings are unverified.

early_discovery.method: RSS-first early detection without a required advertised discount for tightly filtered price signals

urgent_pricing_error.trigger: explicit pricing-error phrase in title AND unambiguous price in title AND selected category or known brand

branded_price_watch.trigger: promotional wording AND exactly one € price in source post headline AND recognized brand or preferred interior style AND verified direct FR/ES/IT Amazon product URL

public_offer_history.observation: Single reported EUR price per distinct RSS deal post with an identifiable exact Amazon marketplace ASIN
public_offer_history.disclaimer: Only past publicly advertised OFFER prices, never true Amazon live/historical prices; may vary by region/seller or be inaccurate.
public_offer_history.storage: Best-effort GitHub Actions cache; data can be evicted or lost

early_discovery.warning: All current prices, vendor trust, actual savings, delivery to France and item availability unverified

search_region.note: Only France, Spain and Italy Amazon marketplaces are eligible for direct product alerts; no UK or US RSS feeds. Delivery to France cannot be checked without checkout credentials.

free_discovery_sources.note: Added themed Dealabs RSS feeds for jardin-bricolage, jeux-jouets, sante-et-cosmetiques, accessoires-gadgets, animaux and culture-divertissement. Availability is checked per run; no paid private API. German Amazon.de (shipping to FR remains unverified); mydealz.de RSS availability is checked during every run.

findings_database.export_every_run: GitHub Actions artifact with index.html, finds.csv, finds.json, catalog.sqlite
findings_database.confidence_rule: Public advertisements only; no actual Amazon price, price history, seller or France delivery verification
findings_database.source_price_ambiguity: Les Numeriques may compare several merchants: article's lowest reported price is never attributed to Amazon automatically.
findings_database.user_access: Open the GitHub Actions workflow run and download diamond-findings-<run_id> from Artifacts, then open catalog_export/index.html.
findings_database.note: Archive persists across scheduled runs while GitHub Actions cache is available. GitHub cache and downloadable artifacts have retention limits and are not permanent external storage.

product_exclusions.xbox: exclude consoles, games, subscriptions and Xbox-only accessories (keep PC, PlayStation and Nintendo)
product_exclusions.samsung: only Samsung solid-state drives (SSD/NVMe/portable SSD), exclude all other Samsung products and Galaxy accessories
product_exclusions.apply_to: Telegram notifications, new discoveries and previously indexed web storefront cards
product_exclusions.preserve: all PC and PlayStation gaming and components

production_policy.publish: Only direct product pages on Amazon Cdiscount Joybuy, with direct retailer-data provenance
production_policy.no_republication: Dealabs / Mydealz / Chollometro / Brickset / Les Numeriques disabled in production
production_policy.shopping_links: Product URL only; no forum/source buttons
inactive_direct_sources: Cdiscount and Joybuy direct product-price connectors (not yet configured)
